step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an email delivery workflow spanning two main accounts/regions separated by a blue vertical divider line. On the left side, an Application (APP) triggers job queuing into ElastiCache Redis on the right side, while data from Aurora Postgres is written to S3. On the right side (sending infrastructure region), an EC2 instance fleet (Mail Merge) reads job queues from ElastiCache Redis, recipient CSV files from S3, and email templates from Aurora Postgres. It then sends email tasks via a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to another EC2 fleet acting as Mail Transfer Agents (MTAs). The MTAs send emails out to the Internet Recipients (Cloud shape) and log delivery status to Kinesis Firehose, which streams logs back across the account boundary into Aurora Postgres on the left.
